answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with plume-backed beacon tenure: each identity must keep a beacon live that signs a fresh challenge every epoch, and it is only trusted when a plume of independent neighbours attests they observed it doing real, verifiable work that epoch. An identity with no plume, or a plume copied from another beacon, falls into an umber quarantine tier where its votes carry no weight until it rebuilds genuine tenure. A sybil farmer must therefore run a live beacon and earn separate witness support for every fake identity, so cloning adds no free influence.
